rules.statement: There was fraud and collusion within the meaning of section 7 of the Registration of Documents Ordinance, as evidenced by the fiduciary's breach of duty to protect the plaintiff's interests and the defendant's knowledge of this.
rules.supporting_quote: "While the main weight of the argument for the defendant before the Board was put on the hypothesis which their Lordships have rejected, reliance was also placed on the reasons given by the Chief Justice for setting aside the finding of fraud and collusion. The Chief Justice said :- For the purpose of bringing a deed within the ambit of section 7 (2) it is not sufficient to establish that the person who obtained the deed was an unscrupulous person who would take undue advantage of any situation for the purpose of gain or that he had been punished for evasion of revenue laws or that he had committed fraud on previous occasions. Fraud or collusion in obtaining the particular deed in question must be established."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 7 of the Registration of Documents Ordinance
